2608.30963.title: A Universal Context-Reuse Layer for Cross-Model KV Sharing
2608.30963.paper_summary: Modern large language model (LLM) serving systems increasingly operate over repeated or shared context, yet each model typically performs its own prefill computation even when another model has already processed the same input. Existing KV-cache reuse mechanisms substantially reduce redundant computation within a single model, but generally assume that the producer and consumer of a cache are identical. We study \emph{cross-model KV sharing}, which translates the KV state produced by a source model into a representation that can be consumed by a different target model, including models that differ in scale, architecture, attention configuration, tokenizer, and model family. We evaluate the approach in both within-family and cross-family settings. For Qwen2.5-7B $\rightarrow$ Qwen2.5-1.5B, translated KV states improve LongBench2 accuracy from 27.59\% to 34.48\%, a gain of 6.89 percentage points over the native 1.5B baseline, while reducing handoff cost relative to native target prefill. For the cross-family Qwen2.5-1.5B $\rightarrow$ Gemma-2-2B setting, KV handoff reduces target-side prefill cost by up to 67.05\% at 4K context length while maintaining decoding perplexity close to native-model baselines. In a more heterogeneous Llama3.1-70B $\rightarrow$ Qwen2.5-7B setting, cross-family handoff achieves 44.0\% accuracy compared with 45.7\% for native Qwen2.5-7B inference, while reducing measured latency from 899ms to 138ms. These results provide initial evidence that KV states can serve as transferable computational representations rather than strictly model-local caches, and motivate \emph{context mobility} as a systems abstraction for reducing redundant prefill across heterogeneous LLM and multi-agent inference workflows.
2608.30963.paper_summary_zh: 現代大型語言模型（LLM）服務系統越來越多地在重複或共享的上下文中運作，然而每個模型通常仍然執行自己的預填計算，即使另一個模型已經處理了相同的輸入。現有的KV快取重用機制在單一模型內部大幅減少了冗餘計算，但通常假設快取的生產者和消費者是相同的。我們研究\emph{跨模型KV共享}，這將源模型產生的KV狀態轉換為可以被不同目標模型消耗的表示，包括在規模、架構、注意力配置、分詞器和模型家族上有所不同的模型。我們在同家族和跨家族的環境中評估這種方法。對於Qwen2.5-7B $\rightarrow$ Qwen2.5-1.5B，轉換的KV狀態使LongBench2的準確率從27.59\%提高到34.48\%，相較於原生1.5B基準提高了6.89個百分點，同時相對於原生目標預填降低了交接成本。對於跨家族的Qwen2.5-1.5B $\rightarrow$ Gemma-2-2B設置，KV交接在4K上下文長度下將目標端的預填成本降低了多達67.05\%，同時保持解碼困惑度接近原生模型基準。在一個更異質的Llama3.1-70B $\rightarrow$ Qwen2.5-7B設置中，跨家族交接的準確率為44.0\%，而原生Qwen2.5-7B推斷的準確率為45.7\%，同時將測量的延遲從899毫秒降低到138毫秒。這些結果提供了初步證據，表明KV狀態可以作為可轉移的計算表示，而不僅僅是嚴格的模型本地快取，並激勵\emph{上下文流動性}作為一種系統抽象，以減少異質LLM和多代理推斷工作流程中的冗餘預填。
